voice_script.hook_line: Oh, look at this adorable sleepy cat! Those soft little paws and that fluffy fur — I think it might be dreaming right now!
voice_script.transition_line: What if we could peek inside this cat's dreams? I'll set the scene, and you tell me what the cat is dreaming about!

rounds.prompt: The cat's whiskers are twitching! It's dreaming about floating through the sky on a fluffy cloud. What does it see up there?
rounds.on_correct: Oh yes! I can see it too — what a magical dream! The cat looks so happy floating up there!
rounds.on_incorrect: What a wonderful dream that would be! Up in the sky, the cat might also see sparkly stars or colorful birds flying by!
rounds.on_silence: Imagine floating on a cloud way up high. What would you see? Maybe birds, stars, or even a rainbow?
rounds.hint: Think about what you see when you look up at the sky — birds, clouds, the sun, stars!

rounds.prompt: Now the cat's paws are paddling! It's dreaming about swimming in a magical ocean made of warm milk. What does it find down there?
rounds.on_correct: Amazing! A milk ocean full of treasures — this cat has the most wonderful imagination!
rounds.on_incorrect: That's so creative! In a magical milk ocean, the cat might also find shimmering fish or sparkling treasure chests!
rounds.on_silence: Picture a warm, cozy ocean made of milk. What magical things could be swimming around down there? Maybe fish, or hidden treasure?
rounds.hint: Think about what you might find in a magical ocean — treasure, colorful fish, sparkling shells!

rounds.prompt: The cat is purring so loudly now! It's dreaming about a magical garden where everything is made of its favorite things. What grows in this garden?
rounds.on_correct: That's the purr-fect dream garden! No wonder the cat is purring so loudly — it's the happiest dream ever!
rounds.on_incorrect: What a delightful garden! The cat might also dream about yarn trees and treat bushes growing everywhere!
rounds.on_silence: If you could grow anything in a magical garden, what would it be? The cat might dream about its favorite treats or toys growing like flowers!
rounds.hint: Think about what a cat loves most — treats, yarn, toys — now imagine those growing in a garden!

voice_script.closing_speech: You are the most wonderful Dream Whisperer! You peeked into three amazing dreams — floating in the sky, swimming in a milk ocean, and exploring a magical garden. Each dream came from your incredible Reflection — you thought about what the cat might feel and imagine. That's a truly special power!
voice_script.tomorrow_hook: Next time you see a sleeping cat, try whispering a dream to it — who knows what magical adventures it might have!
voice_script.early_exit_speech: That was such a lovely dream adventure together! The cat is still dreaming away happily. We can peek at more dreams anytime you want!
